subject.title: fix(opencode-go): expose DeepSeek V4 max thinking levels

question: Should OpenCode Go DeepSeek V4 users who request `xhigh` or `max` now receive provider effort `max` across cold Gateway projection and active runtime, while lower levels continue to use `high`?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and proof-backed, but enabling a previously clamped request changes provider cost/latency behavior and establishes a durable provider capability contract.

options.title: Accept the capability correction
options.body: Merge the focused provider-owned profile and metadata so DeepSeek V4 exposes `xhigh` and `max` consistently before and after plugin activation.

options.title: Keep the existing clamp
options.body: Decline the capability expansion if OpenCode Go should intentionally continue treating only `high` as supported for these models.

recommendation.title: Accept the capability correction
recommendation.body: Merge the focused provider-owned profile and metadata so DeepSeek V4 exposes `xhigh` and `max` consistently before and after plugin activation.
